_comment: Tags excluded from default PR Maestro batches. Zephyr tier labels: detox/maestro/README.md.
_MM-T5611: Skip iOS: CI run 30000635898 — external browser launch did not return to the Home tab.
_MM-T3260: Skip Android: CI run 30331493720 (PR #9893, SHA 9f1496e) — help_url.yml failed with 'Unable to launch app com.mattermost.rnbeta' after ~136s (batch-7); already excluded on iOS for browser hand-off flakes. Chrome Custom Tab hand-off leaves the driver unable to relaunch the app on API 35.
_DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION: The 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' failures below were NOT login failures. wait_for_server_connect_complete.yml marked the login-form wait optional and then asserted the home tab, so a failed SERVER CONNECT was reported with a login error message. Proof: on run 30466684108 the app issued ZERO /api/v4 requests and logged 'getServerUrlAfterRedirect error' — it never left the server form, so login.yml never executed. Two distinct connect causes were found: (1) TLS trust evaluation cancelled against a valid Let's Encrypt chain (NSURLErrorDomain -1200 + NSURLErrorFailingURLPeerTrustErrorKey, 'Cancelled during verify block' x4 in the red run, x0 in the green run 30437339535) while the runner itself reached the same host over HTTPS to seed data; (2) inputText dropped ~30 characters of SITE_1_URL, so the app connected to 'h-1-tjrchzrq.test.mattermost.cloud' and got 'hostname could not be found' (30447839548 batch-2). Before un-excluding anything below, re-read the sim log for these signatures — do NOT re-tune login.yml.
_MM-T1325: Skip iOS: CI run 30334294934 (PR #9893, SHA 347842c) — clock_display.yml failed with 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' (~215s). _MM-T67856_1_2: Skip iOS: both flows PASSED on run 30424009936 (#9893, f86f99e) and FAILED on run 30447839548 (72c6f256c) with identical code — same config, opposite outcomes. Failure is 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' (~232-282s). See _DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION: batch-1 of that run was the TLS trust cancellation and batch-2 was the dropped-keystroke URL corruption — neither is a login flake, and the login.yml retry/eraseText/100s-home-wait changes made for these tags were tuning a subflow that never ran. Keep Android coverage — both flows pass there (~108-143s).
_SEC-11051_STATUS: SEC-11051 follow-up (CORRECTS the first-pass 'foundation on main covers it' claim). Checked PR #9971 (ca20a9a20, merged) line-by-line against the ticket's two requirements: (b) mislabel fix SATISFIED — #9971 added wait_for_server_connect_complete.yml with the non-optional notVisible:server_form.display_help FIRST, so a failed connect fails in connect context, not as 'tab_bar.home.tab is visible' (the comment documents this). (a) set-and-verify URL input MISSING — _enter_url_and_connect.yml does inputText:SITE_1_URL then taps Connect with NO assertion that the field equals SITE_1_URL before submit; it only re-enters (mitigates dropped keystrokes, does not verify). Not implemented this pass: the set-and-verify would be an unverifiable change to a shared subflow used by EVERY iOS Maestro test (an assertVisible id+text on server_form.server_url.input, or a runScript field-value compare) — if Maestro cannot read the controlled RN TextInput's value as text the assertion always fails and breaks the whole iOS suite, and this pass cannot run Maestro to confirm (no live server; cold-start TLS is the ticket's own subject). To land: add the assertion in _enter_url_and_connect.yml after inputText and verify on a stable server that it passes on a correct URL and fails loudly on a truncated one. TLS cold-start: #9971's _connect_check.yml WARMS trust evaluation (runs the connect path up front) but does NOT fix the cancellation (NSURLErrorDomain -1200) — mitigated, not fixed; not re-verified this pass (no Maestro run). Dropped-keystroke: mitigated (re-enter), not verified-fixed (no set-and-verify). MM-T67856_1/_2 stay iOS-excluded. SEC-11000 (MM-T1325) / SEC-11018 (MM-T5611) already iOS-excluded with _DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION references.
